ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: The Prevention and Suppression of Money Laundering Activities Law, L. 188(I)/2007, as amended, transposing EU Directives (EU) 2015/849 and (EU) 2018/843; Companies Law, Cap. 113, ss. 63A-63J (Beneficial Owners Register), inserted by the Companies (Amendment) Law L. 39(I)/2021; Income Tax Law L. 118(I)/2002; sectoral AML/CFT Directives of the Cyprus Bar Association, the Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission, and the Institute of Certified Public Accountants of Cyprus; MOKAS (Cyprus FIU) guidelines and supervisory practice.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin or Cyprus-licensed notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (1961 Hague Convention) where the country of origin is a Contracting State; otherwise consular legalization through the competent Cyprus consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or account-holding bank in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certification; apostille or consular legalization required only if issued as a certified extract by a foreign public authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter (professional opinion) confirming account conduct for each subscriber
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding bank in the applicant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct confidential transmission to the licensed Cyprus corporate services provider; apostille not required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum and Articles of Association of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization in accordance with the issuing registry's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney executed in favour of the licensed Cyprus corporate services provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed UBO declaration and AML due diligence questionnaire (beneficial ownership chart)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each ultimate beneficial owner and each director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarised signature in accordance with s. 68 of L. 188(I)/2007

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP screening of each UBO, director, and authorised signatory under s. 61A of L. 188(I)/2007 and MOKAS guidance; mandatory screening against OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council sanctions list, and the Cyprus Ministry of Finance domestic sanctions list. Enhanced due diligence and a 12-month post-office monitoring window apply to PEPs under CySEC Directive DI144-2014-14, s. 65. Adverse media and negative news checks are required; all CDD records must be retained for five years after termination of the business relationship under s. 68 of the AML Law.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Cyprus Companies Portal (e-Filing) of the Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver, Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry (https://efiling.companies.gov.cy) and the public name-search facility maintained by the Registrar at https://www.companies.gov.cy
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed name must be submitted in Latin (English) characters; the Registrar records the name in both English and Greek transliteration in the respective registers. The suffix 'Limited', 'Ltd', or its Greek equivalent 'Λτδ' is required. Only letters A-Z, Arabic numerals, and limited punctuation are accepted. The name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing registered name, must not imply public authority or a regulated activity, and must not be confusingly similar to an EU or Cyprus protected designation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: File the name application through the Cyprus Companies Portal. If the Registrar refuses the name, the refusal notice states the grounds. The applicant may, within 14 days of the refusal, submit a written review request to the Registrar under s. 12 of Companies Law, Cap. 113, attaching any required ministerial or regulatory consents (e.g., Central Bank of Cyprus, CySEC, Ministry of Finance) for sensitive tokens. If the Registrar upholds the refusal, the applicant may file an administrative recourse before the Administrative Court of Cyprus against the Registrar's decision. Alternatively, a fresh application with modified tokens may be submitted, attracting a new 180-day reservation window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. Companies Law, Cap. 113, s. 120 requires a physical registered office in Cyprus; a PO Box or unstaffed virtual address alone is not compliant. For this low-risk ESG carbon advisory and audit brokerage entity, an office-as-a-service arrangement operated by a licensed administrative services provider satisfies the registration requirement, provided the provider maintains staffed premises in Cyprus and board meetings and management decisions are conducted such that central management and control does not migrate to another jurisdiction under s. 2 of Income Tax Law L. 118(I)/2002 and prevailing Cyprus tax-residency substance practice.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified annual risk of 15% that the Cyprus Tax Department or the Registrar of Companies conducts an unannounced substance inspection during the first operating cycle. The likelihood is estimated at 30-40% where the registered-office arrangement is a non-staffed virtual mailbox without local administrative staff, reflecting special-purpose substance audits targeting licensed fiduciary and administrative service providers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law, Cap. 113 (Sections 4–8, 31–35, 51, 173–177), as amended by subsequent harmonization laws.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver, Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Republic of Cyprus
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association, together with the statutory declaration of compliance (Form HE2), submitted for the Certificate of Incorporation (HE number).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital or escrow account requirement applies to a private limited company under the Companies Law, Cap. 113. The company may incorporate with a nominal issued share capital and pay up at a later date; in practice, a paid-up capital of at least EUR 1,000–2,000 is often required for corporate bank account onboarding.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by written consent of the initial directors and subscribers, that: (1) all initial shares are allotted and taken up as shown in the register of members, with consideration credited to paid-up capital; (2) the registered office of the company is established at the address recorded in the formation documents; (3) [Director A] and [Director B] are appointed first directors, and [Secretary] is appointed company secretary, each with the powers granted by the Articles; (4) the directors are authorized to open bank accounts, execute formation filings, and complete tax and social-insurance registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver — Corporate Administration Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a search in the Registrar's company name index to confirm the proposed name is distinguishable and not prohibited. Submit Form HE1, the name reservation application, with the proposed name in Greek and/or English, a brief statement of corporate objects, and the prescribed reservation fee. Obtain the official name-approval certificate before proceeding.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney to the local corporate service provider
Photographic identification of the applicant or ultimate beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as indistinguishable, misleading, or contrary to public policy, file a new Form HE1 with alternative names or submit a written request for reconsideration to the Registrar within 30 days of refusal. A further appeal may be made to the District Court under the Companies Law, Cap. 113.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cyprus notary public and corporate services provider; Registrar's pre-examination unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the Companies Law, Cap. 113 and Table A, or adopt a tailored institutional standard. Each subscriber must initial and sign every page physically before a Cyprus notary public. Append the signed consents of the first directors and the company secretary. Prepare the documents in Greek or English, with the Greek text prevailing where a conflict is possible.
required_dossiers: Signed consent of each first director
Signed consent of the company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar's pre-examination queries a clause, execute a notarized addendum or revised Memorandum and Articles of Association and resubmit. No new name approval is required unless the registered corporate name is changed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing, Fee Payment, and Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver — Companies Formation Desk and online business registration e-portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association, consents of directors and secretary, registered-office consent, and declaration of compliance through the e-portal or in person. Pay the prescribed registration fees, comprising the name reservation fee and incorporation fee. The Registrar examines the application under the Companies Law, Cap. 113, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the HE company number.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to registered office and notice of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or rejection notice, respond in writing within 21 days, correcting the corporate objects, declarations, or any inconsistencies. If the application is rejected, file a clean corrected application or pursue judicial review before the District Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Officers and Corporate Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver; commercial banks supervised by the Central Bank of Cyprus
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the particulars of the directors, company secretary, and registered office with the Registrar and obtain the official company extract. Hold the first board meeting and issue the pro-forma first board resolution, including certified signatories. Submit the original Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, board resolution, and beneficial ownership information to a licensed Cyprus bank for account opening and customer due diligence.
required_dossiers: First board resolution and signatory mandate
Passport, proof of address, and CV of each director and ultimate beneficial owner
Bank account application and AML declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any mismatch in officer particulars by filing a notice of change with the Registrar and resubmitting the updated extract to the bank. If the bank refuses the application due to insufficient documentation, provide additional source-of-funds evidence or apply to another licensed Cyprus credit institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Insurance, and Beneficial Ownership Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cyprus Tax Department, Social Insurance Services, and the Registrar of Companies for the Ultimate Beneficial Owner Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company for corporate income tax through the Tax For All portal within 60 days of incorporation. Register as an employer with the Social Insurance Services and comply with the General Healthcare System contribution obligations. Register for VAT if taxable turnover exceeds EUR 15,600 or voluntarily if required for ESG and carbon audit services. Submit the Beneficial Ownership statement to the Registrar within 30 days of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Identification data of directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners
Tax and social insurance registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration is cured by filing the relevant registration form and, where applicable, submitting a reasoned penalty waiver request to the Tax Commissioner. Any query from the Tax Department is remedied by providing the requested constitutional and identity documents through the Tax For All portal within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating Permit and Workplace Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Nicosia Municipality, Department of Labour Inspection, and Cyprus Fire Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to the relevant municipal authority for a general business operating permit covering the professional services office. Arrange a fire-safety certificate from an approved fire-safety engineer and submit it to the Cyprus Fire Service where staff are present. Conduct and document a workplace risk assessment under the Safety and Health at Work Law 89(I)/1996.
required_dossiers: Registered office lease agreement or title deed
Fire-safety certificate or risk assessment report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality or Labour Department requires remedial measures, implement the stated control measures within the compliance deadline and submit a written compliance report. If the permit is refused, file a written reconsideration request with the municipality and, if necessary, appeal to the Administrative Court within the statutory limitation period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sectoral industrial licence applies to ISIC 7020 management consultancy, carbon accounting, and ESG auditing. General administrative licensing is administered by the local municipal authority (Nicosia Municipality) and the Department of Labour Inspection, Ministry of Labour, Welfare and Social Insurance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Local Municipal General Business Operating Permit (not a sector-specific commercial or manufacturing licence)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Environment, Republic of Cyprus
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 4 administrative professional office; no Environmental Impact Assessment or preliminary environmental assessment is required under the EIA Law for professional services. A commercial waste-collection registration is required for the office's non-hazardous waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge or VOC emission sources exist in the carbon audit office environment. Compliance applies under the Waste Management Law 185(I)/2011 for municipal solid waste, recyclable paper, and electronic waste. Waste must be collected by an authorized waste carrier, and office-generated WEEE and batteries must be surrendered to licensed recyclers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety clearance and certificate from an approved fire-safety engineer filed with the Cyprus Fire Service; structural and load certification by the building owner or a qualified civil engineer confirming the office meets applicable urban building standards; and workplace clearance under the Safety and Health at Work Law 89(I)/1996, including periodic electrical equipment inspection, fire drills, first-aid arrangements, and ergonomic risk assessment for employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Tax Department of the Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Cyprus; online filing and registration portal: Ariadni (accessible via taxdep.gov.cy)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign or domestic private limited company applies to the District Tax Office by completing the VAT/Income Tax registration application and submitting the certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, proof of registered office, identity documents of directors and shareholders, and, if the company is non-resident, a local tax representative appointment form. The Tax Department issues the Cyprus Tax Identification Number and, where applicable, the VAT number for Cypriot permanent establishments or resident entities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; Cyprus incorporated companies are tax resident and subject to corporate income tax on worldwide income at 12.5%, with territorial limitations applicable to non-resident companies under double tax treaties and Cypriot domestic source rules.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election is available under Cyprus law. Available statutory elections and reliefs include the notional interest deduction election, group relief election, foreign tax credit election, dividend participation exemption, election to tax royalty/interest income at 15% or exempt treatment, and hybrid mismatch alignment rules under ATAD provisions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CYP 15,600 taxable turnover in the preceding 12 months for established taxable persons; non-established suppliers have no registration threshold for taxable supplies in Cyprus; intra-Community distance sales threshold is CYP 10,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Cyprus does not currently mandate real-time fiscal clearance, API-linked billing, or digital stamping for B2B invoices. VAT returns and related data must be submitted electronically through the Tax Department's Ariadni portal; e-invoicing is compulsory only in public procurement transactions pursuant to EU Directive 2014/55/EU.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% VAT rate applies to supplies of goods dispatched or transported to destinations outside the European Union, to intra-Community supplies to VAT-registered customers in other EU Member States, and to certain export-related services (e.g., transport, loading and ancillary services) where the requisite place-of-supply rules and CMR/Customs documentation are satisfied. For offshore B2B services to non-EU customers, zero-rating applies where the service is 'used and enjoyed' outside Cyprus or qualifies under the reverse charge/place-of-supply rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document / SAD)
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or equivalent transport proof
Inward Remittance Certificate or other bank transfer/payment proof where required
Contract or purchase order evidencing the export transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Cyprus Tax Department may reverse zero-rated export treatment and issue retroactive VAT assessments if the substantiation chain is incomplete or inconsistent. Legal consequences include undergraduate interest at 9% per annum, administrative fines of up to 100% of tax due, and criminal prosecution for fraudulent evasion or forged export documents, with potential imprisonment and higher financial penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Cyprus (Κεντρική Τράπεζα της Κύπρου), operating within the Eurosystem and the Single Supervisory Mechanism (SSM) for significant credit institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility applies in both current and capital accounts. Cyprus is an IMF Article VIII member since 2004 and adopted the euro on 1 January 2008; the former Exchange Control Law (Cap. 199) has been wholly repealed, and no approval or registration requirement impedes cross-border capital movements. Profit remittance of dividends, interest, royalties, and liquidation proceeds to non-resident shareholders is unrestricted, subject only to ordinary corporate formality: audited financials, board resolution on distribution, and zero Cyprus withholding tax under the participation exemption regime; the 12.5% corporate income tax applies at entity level only.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender timeline or mandatory conversion ratio applies. Export and fee receipts denominated in USD, GBP, or other currencies may be retained in foreign-currency accounts indefinitely or converted to EUR at the bank's prevailing interbank rate. Reporting obligations are limited to transactional data transmitted to the Central Bank of Cyprus for balance-of-payments statistics and to the Cyprus Unit for Combating Money Laundering (MOKAS) under L.188(I)/2007 and Regulation (EU) 2015/847; no foreign-exchange surrender requirement exists.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Cyprus Public Company Ltd
Cyprus Development Bank Public Company Ltd

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-Low. EEA-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) may lawfully serve the Cyprus entity through EEA PSD2 passporting and may offer EUR payment accounts where their EEA e-money authorisation permits. Legal constraints include: (i) no direct participation in the national SEPA/TARGET clearing without commercial-bank sponsorship; (ii) EMI segregation and no-lending rules materially reduce utility for capital escrow; (iii) several offshore digital EMIs decline Cyprus corporate registrants handling carbon-audit data sets, citing counterparty sanctions-scoping difficulty. Recommended deployment: a secondary collection rail for recurring, low-value client fee payments, with Bank of Cyprus or Hellenic Bank retained as the principal clearing bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory physical-appearance requirement applies. Remote onboarding is permitted with: notarised and apostilled corporate resolutions; certified passport copies of directors, shareholders, and UBOs; a recent Certificate of Incorporation, Register of Directors, and Memorandum & Articles of Association; and a confirmed registered-office address. Tier-1 banks will require the company secretary or a director to complete a live video interview with the compliance officer; a physical branch visit is requested only for medium/high-risk relationships or when the UBO is resident in a non-FATF-compliant state. A low-risk ESG professional-services profile normally completes onboarding remotely within 25 calendar days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO/shareholder resident in a FATF grey-listed or non-compliant jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth file comprising audited financial statements, a Cyprus tax residence certificate, UBO Register filing confirmation, five years of supporting bank statements, and a letter from a licensed Cypriot lawyer confirming documentary verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound fee flows originating from carbon registries outside the EU (e.g., Verra/Gold Standard marketplaces)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed ESG engagement agreements per client, registry account statements proving audit attestation, itemised invoices aligned to planned deliverables, and a payment-flow narrative tying each counterparty to its funding jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Projected annual turnover disproportionate to declared staff and office substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-year audited financial projections, Cyprus social insurance and VAT records, an ESG team organogram, and reference letters from two domestic regulated professional firms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee or opaque trust structures in the ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full beneficial-ownership declaration entered on the Cyprus Beneficial Ownership Register, the trust deed and UBO declaration, a chain-of-title organisational chart, and a legal opinion confirming the absence of bearer or nominee share arrangements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicion of crypto-native or tokenised settlement of carbon credits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A board resolution prohibiting crypto-asset settlement, the compliance manual page requiring fiat-only reconciliation, and counterparty side-letters confirming exclusive SWIFT/SEPA settlement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) Incoming wire via SWIFT MT103 or SEPA transfer referencing the Cyprus private limited company name, its Registry of Companies registration number (HE format), and the designated Capital Escrow Account IBAN; (2) purpose classification reported as an equity subscription or intercompany capital injection on the Central Bank of Cyprus Balance of Payments (ITRS) reporting form submitted by the receiving bank — no central-bank consent or exchange-control permit is required for investments from EU or non-EU residents; (3) subscriber verification: passport, source-of-funds statement, subscription agreement, and board minutes approving the share issuance; (4) settlement in EUR at the ECB reference rate where the inbound payment is in foreign currency; (5) supporting dossier: updated Articles of Association, Register of Members entry, and Companies Law (Cap. 113) filings confirming issued and paid-up share capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (1) Eurozone counterparties — SEPA Credit Transfer (ISO 20022 pain.001) with same-value-day execution under Uniform EURO Payment conditions; (2) non-EU settlement — SWIFT MT103 referencing the invoice and carbon-credit registry identifier; (3) high-value carbon-credit purchases — SWIFT MT700 documentary letter of credit under UCP600 with MT798 confirmation, or standby LC where delivery-based certification applies; (4) disbursement verification through SWIFT MT199/CAMT.054 statements reconciled in the accounting system and electronic invoices filed with the Cyprus Tax Department e-invoicing portal; (5) counterparty whitelisting and dual-approval disbursement controls to prevent route-switching fraud.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CHF) under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement or the bank's master FX terms, tenors up to 12 months, collateralised where required

FX Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) where the carbon registry's settlement currency is not fully deliverable (e.g., legacy CNY, INR, or BRL registry flows), transacted with the principal Cyprus bank as principal
FX Swaps (spot-forward and forward-forward) for staging EUR liquidity between intercompany capital injections and overseas disbursement dates
FX Options (vanilla put/call and zero-premium collars) for firm USD/GBP audit-fee tender exposure, exercised solely for hedging, in line with MiFID II treasury-exemption provisions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCOR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty escalates by EUR 75 per month (maximum EUR 350). Persistent non-payment triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution under Cyprus Companies Law.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form HE32) together with Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Registrar of Companies and Official Receiver (DRCOR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine on the company and each officer in default; three consecutive years of non-filing leads to Registrar-initiated strike-off and dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cyprus Beneficial Ownership portal (administered by DRCOR / Ministry of Justice)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 14 days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EUR 100 per offence; continued default may result in de-registration or criminal sanctions against officers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 December following the end of the tax year (tax year = calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed EUR 100 late-filing penalty plus interest on unpaid tax; persistent non-filing may trigger estimated assessment and criminal prosecution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Cyprus private limited company qualifies for audit exemption as a 'small company' if it meets at least two of three criteria: balance-sheet total ≤ EUR 6 million; net turnover ≤ EUR 12 million; average employees ≤ 50. Mandatory audit is required where the company is a public-interest entity, exceeds the small-company thresholds for two consecutive years, forms part of a consolidated group required to produce audited accounts, or carries on a regulated activity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as endorsed by the EU; IFRS for SMEs is permitted for small non-public-interest companies; financial statements must be prepared in euro and filed with the annual return.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, within 14 days of the incorporation anniversary, a confirmation must be submitted through the Cyprus Beneficial Ownership (CyBO) registry stating that the registered beneficial ownership details are true and accurate. Any change in shareholders or beneficial ownership (including share transfers) must be reported to the CyBO portal within 14 days of the event. The confirmation is signed by an authorized officer and failure to file incurs administrative penalties.
